chapters.title: Challenge: Inconsistent talent flow and training burden
Solution: Upskill program reduces internal training workload
Benefits: External perspectives and Microsoft brand appeal
Program graduates enter with technical and soft skills
Measurable impact: 14 hires from 150 qualified candidates

features.name: BC Talent program
features.description: A talent recruitment and training initiative that enables partners to identify and onboard young talent trained in Business Central. Partners can recruit qualified graduates who have completed technical and soft skills training.

features.name: Upskill program
features.description: A training program integrated with the BC Talent initiative that enables partners to reduce their internal onboarding workload by moving significant portions of training to the program, which covers both technical skills about Business Central and consultant soft skills.

features.name: BC Talent community
features.description: A global community where BC Talent program participants and partners can support each other, exchange knowledge, and collaborate across geographies including the US and Asia.

quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the core business problem that BC Talent addresses for partners: unpredictable and insufficient recruitment pipeline
